groups.title: Zoldyck Family
groups.def: Zoldycks by blood or marriage, as listed under 'Family Members' in the wiki's Zoldyck household: Zeno, Silva, his wife Kikyo and their five children Illumi, Milluki, Killua, Alluka and Kalluto (great-grandfather Maha isn't in this file). Kalluto still counts after joining the Phantom Troupe. The household's servants (Gotoh, Canary, Tsubone, Amane, Zebro, Seaquant) don't count.

groups.title: Zoldyck Servants
groups.def: Servants of the Zoldyck household shown in the 2011 anime, as listed under 'Servants' in the wiki's Zoldyck household: the butlers Gotoh, Tsubone and Amane, apprentice butler Canary, and the groundskeepers Zebro and Seaquant. Gotoh counts even though Hisoka kills him. Family members don't count.

groups.title: Phantom Troupe
groups.def: Everyone the 2011 anime shows as a member of Chrollo's Phantom Troupe at any point: leader Chrollo; Nobunaga, Machi, Franklin, Feitan, Phinks, Shizuku, Shalnark, Bonolenov and Kortopi (Shalnark's and Kortopi's deaths are manga-only); Uvogin and Pakunoda, who die in Yorknew; Hisoka, the fake #4 who leaves; and Kalluto, shown as the newest member (ep 72). Illumi joins only in the manga.

groups.title: Enhancers
groups.def: Characters the 2011 anime itself says or shows are Enhancers: Gon and Wing (water divination, ep 35), Palm (her Hatsu makes her tea overflow and Gon calls her an Enhancer, ep 86), Uvogin (stated when he fights the Shadow Beasts, ch. 79, adapted in eps 45-46) and Phinks (his Huncyclopedia segment, ep 51). Types known only from the manga, databooks or Togashi's 2018 Nen chart don't count, so Netero, Nobunaga, Gotoh and Ikalgo are out.

groups.title: Transmuters
groups.def: Characters the 2011 anime itself says or shows are Transmuters: Killua (water divination, ep 35), Hisoka (says so himself, eps 35-36), Machi (stated when she tracks Uvogin's captors, ch. 78, adapted in ep 45), Biscuit (Hisoka sizes her up as a Transmuter, ch. 158, adapted in ep 68) and Feitan (his Huncyclopedia segment, ep 55). Types known only from the manga, databooks or Togashi's 2018 Nen chart don't count, so Menthuthuyoupi is out.

groups.title: Specialists
groups.def: Characters the 2011 anime itself says or shows are Specialists: Neferpitou (water divination, ep 84), Kurapika (a Conjurer who becomes a Specialist while his eyes are scarlet, ep 47), Chrollo (Zeno works it out, ch. 98, adapted in ep 52), Pakunoda (ch. 105, adapted in ep 54) and Neon (ch. 110, adapted in ep 56). Types known only from the manga, databooks or Togashi's 2018 Nen chart don't count, so Meleoron and Alluka are out.

groups.title: The Zodiacs
groups.def: The twelve original Zodiacs, Chairman Netero's advisors, who run the 13th Chairman Election in the anime: Pariston (Rat), Mizaistom (Ox), Kanzai (Tiger), Pyon (Rabbit), Botobai (Dragon), Gel (Snake), Saccho (Horse), Ginta (Sheep), Saiyu (Monkey), Cluck (Rooster), Cheadle (Dog) and Ging (Boar). Netero appointed them but isn't one, and Kurapika and Leorio join only in the manga.

groups.title: Meruem and the Royal Guard
groups.def: Meruem, the Chimera Ant King, and his three Royal Guards (Neferpitou, Shaiapouf, Menthuthuyoupi).

groups.title: Chimera Ants
groups.def: Characters who are Chimera Ants in the anime: the Queen's children Meruem, Neferpitou, Shaiapouf, Menthuthuyoupi, Colt, Welfin, Ikalgo and Meleoron; Kite, killed by Neferpitou and reborn as the Queen's last child; and Palm, captured and reborn as a Chimera Ant soldier (eps 123-124). No other character in this file is an ant.

groups.title: Razor's dodgeball match
groups.def: Characters in the Greed Island dodgeball match against the Game Master Razor: Razor himself and, on Gon's team, Gon, Killua, Biscuit and Hisoka (Goreinu and Tsezguerra's team aren't in this file). Genthru and Ging weren't in it.

groups.title: Took the 287th Hunter Exam
groups.def: Characters shown taking the 287th Hunter Exam (Gon's exam), whether or not they passed; Illumi took it disguised as Gittarackur. The examiners don't count.

groups.title: At Heavens Arena
groups.def: Characters the 2011 anime shows at Heavens Arena (eps 27-36, the only episodes set there): Gon, Killua and Zushi, who fight there; their teacher Wing; floor master Hisoka; and Machi, who stitches Hisoka's arms back after his match with Kastro (ep 32). Characters only seen there in flashbacks or pictures don't count, and Chrollo's fight with Hisoka there is manga-only.

groups.title: The main four
groups.def: The four main characters of the series, as listed on the wiki's 'Main Characters' navbox: Gon, Killua, Kurapika and Leorio.

groups.title: Chimera Ant Extermination Team
groups.def: Members of Netero's Chimera Ant Extermination Team: Netero, Morel and Knov, their pupils Knuckle, Shoot and Palm, Gon and Killua, and the two defecting ants Ikalgo and Meleoron. Zeno (secretly hired for the Dragon Dive) and Colt are only listed as associates; Kite's earlier expedition came before the team.

groups.title: Died in the anime
groups.def: Characters who die in the 2011 anime, on or off screen: Uvogin and Pakunoda (Yorknew), Dalzollene (killed by Phinks, ep 45), Kite (killed by Neferpitou; he counts even though he is later reborn as an ant), Netero, Neferpitou, Menthuthuyoupi, Shaiapouf and Meruem (Chimera Ant arc), and Gotoh (killed by Hisoka, ep 142). Shalnark's and Kortopi's deaths and Neon's presumed death are manga-only; Palm is remodeled, not killed.

groups.title: Nostrade Family
groups.def: The Nostrade mafia family and its employees shown in the anime: boss Light Nostrade, his daughter Neon, head bodyguard Dalzollene, and the bodyguards Kurapika, Senritsu and Basho. (Squala, Linssen and the other guards aren't in this file.)

groups.title: 287th Hunter Exam examiners
groups.def: The examiners of the 287th Hunter Exam: Satotz (Phase 1), Menchi and Buhara (Phase 2), Lippo (Phase 3, who also briefs Phase 4) and Chairman Netero (final phase). Hisoka only 'played examiner' as an applicant.
